Subject: Recap & confirmation: training exclusion, retention, and logging controls (Nimbus Health)

Hi Alice — thanks again for your time today. Quick recap from our side plus the next steps we agreed on: 

- Ask you made: Nimbus Health requires that customer content (including PII) not be used to train or improve any Redwood models. This includes fine-tuning, gradient updates, or mixing into public training corpora.
- Data residency: workloads will be served and stored in our US region only (no cross-region replication).
- Logging and retention: request for request/response logs to be retained for 45 days for debugging and audit, with an option to shorten to 7 days.
- Proofs: you asked for a short written confirmation from us that we will adhere to the training exclusion and for the addendum language to push into procurement.

Attached is a draft mutual action plan we use for pilots (MUTUAL_ACTION_PLAN_NIMBUS_20261124.xlsx). Lauren is copied to own the addendum and signing flow. Marcus is on the SLA/ops side and will loop in infra if we need a special VPC/export path.

Next steps we propose: 
1) Lauren to send the standard training exclusion addendum and the variant with 7-day vs 45-day retention clauses by EOD tomorrow.
2) Nimbus (Raj/Procurement) to confirm which retention window you prefer and provide the procurement contact for DocuSign.
3) Once addendum is signed, we will flag the account to opt out of model training and implement the logging retention change in the tenant config (expected within 3 business days after signature).

If that captures everything, please reply with a one-line confirmation so we can mark the requirement in the deal and start the addendum.

Thanks — talk soon.

— Priyom

- We confirm the ask: no customer data (including PII and PHI) may be used to train or improve Redwood models. This applies to live inference traffic and derivative artifacts.
- Data residency in US-only is required.
- Retention: for the pilot, we are comfortable with 7 days of detailed request/response logs (for debugging). We may request a limited extended retention (45 days) for one month during the initial integration window — will flag if we need this.

- Please include explicit language that excludes "customer content" from training and model improvement.
- Please state the log retention options (7d default; 45d pilot-only extension) and the mechanism to request the extension in writing.
- We will need contact information for your security lead in case we want to run a short questionnaire or request SOC2 artifacts.

Hi Alice / team — per Priyom's recap and your confirmation, attaching the standard training exclusion addendum and a short controls summary. Key points below (excerpted from addendum):

- Training exclusion: Redwood will not use any Customer Content (as defined in the Master Services Agreement) to train, fine-tune, or improve any models in Redwood's product family. This exclusion applies to Golden datasets, public corpora, and internal research.
- Enforcement: Customer accounts flagged with the training_exclusion flag are excluded from our model-improvement pipelines and internal corpora ingestion processes.
- Logs & retention: Default request/response logs retained for 7 days. Temporary extension to 45 days may be granted for a defined pilot period upon written request from the Customer's security or procurement contact; extension must be requested and approved in writing and will be time-bound.
- Data residency: Tenant storage and compute will be provisioned in the US region; no cross-region replication or export without written customer authorization.

Attachments: training_exclusion_addendum_v1.pdf (addendum), MUTUAL_ACTION_PLAN_NIMBUS_20261124.xlsx (action plan). Please confirm which retention window you want for the pilot and provide the procurement contact for DocuSign. Once we get the signed addendum we'll change the tenant flag and apply the retention policy (execution target: within 3 business days).

If you want a short phone call to walk through the addendum language, Marcus and I are available today between 1–3pm PT.
